name: AUTO LINGO Student Report Card
rules: Never invent scores or progress when source data is missing.
Evaluate practical work using documented performance, workmanship and safety criteria.
Show progress over time only when historical assessments exist.
Provide actionable recommendations and next lesson.
Use Persian RTL layout with English technical terms where useful.
implementation_note: Application/reporting configuration, not a relational database entity. Store in app configuration or assessment service unless a dedicated schema is designed.
